# Question: generator-shortcuts

> For this generator, name the strongest plausible shortcut or rival rule that
> fits the canonical demonstrations. Give an exact input on which it disagrees
> with the intended rule, how you checked the output, and whether your proposed
> generator emits such cases.

## Answer

The strongest compact rival is **`any_junction_red`**: recolor a green
component red whenever it contains either a degree-3 or a degree-4 cell; absent
a junction, use the intended exactly-two-turn magenta branch and otherwise blue.
It fits all four canonical demonstrations because none contains a degree-4
junction that distinguishes it from the intended degree-3-only rule.

An exact generated counterexample is the 10×20 input from seed `7700`, sample
index `0`, difficulty `medium`, final generator SHA-256
`b0ebe6d546dab4c0d4fe8c8163bfa4325f75e6652f586a69735644c8d01a4271`.
All cells are background `0` except these zero-based green (`3`) coordinates:

```text
(4,7) (4,8)
(5,7)
(6,2) (6,7) (6,17)
(7,1) (7,2) (7,3) (7,7) (7,8) (7,9) (7,15) (7,16) (7,17)
(8,2) (8,17)
```

The component at `{(6,2),(7,1),(7,2),(7,3),(8,2)}` is a degree-4 plus. The
canonical rule colors all five cells blue (`1`); `any_junction_red` colors them
red (`2`). Those five cells are the complete disagreement set. The full array is
retained verbatim in `checks/question/generator-shortcuts/input.json`, and the
rival output is in `checks/question/generator-shortcuts/probe.json`.

I checked the intended output by executing the selected bundled Racket authority
with `RULE_HASH = 6b0505b049ac`, not by trusting the Python mirror. The receipt is
`checks/question/generator-shortcuts/racket.json`; the source/rule/domain and
five-cell comparison are independently summarized in
`checks/question/generator-shortcuts/confirmation.json`.

Yes, the production generator emits this distinction deliberately: every even
sample index requires a degree-4 blue plus, while odd indices require the other
canonical shortcut witness, a three-turn blue path. The 300-lesson census found
that every three-demonstration lesson and every one-pair-held-out rotation
refuted this rival and the `at_least_two_corners_magenta` rival.
